blocks.prompt: 8 The point \(A\) is mapped to \((30, 20, -5)\) by the scaling matrix \(P = \begin{bmatrix}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix}\). Find the coordinates of \(A\). [Hint: If \(A\) is mapped to \(A'\) by scaling matrix \(P\), then \(AP = A'\)]
blocks.explanation:
A scaling question worked backwards: the image is known, the original point is not.
We must find \(A\).
Plan: write \(A\) as a row \([a\ b\ c]\), form \(AP = A'\), compare entries, check.
steps:
Given: \(A\) is mapped to \(A' = (30, 20, -5)\) by \(P = \begin{bmatrix}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix}\).
To find: the coordinates of \(A\).
Method: Use the hint \(AP = A'\) with \(A = [a\ \ b\ \ c]\) a row matrix; multiply out and compare entries.

Write \(AP = A'\)
\[[a\ \ b\ \ c]\begin{bmatrix}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix} = [30\ \ 20\ \ -5]\]
Why: A row matrix \(1 \times 3\) times a \(3 \times 3\) matrix gives a \(1 \times 3\) row, the same shape as \(A'\).

Multiply row by columns
\[[-5a + 0 + 0\ \ \ 0 - 5b + 0\ \ \ 0 + 0 - 5c]\]
\[= [-5a\ \ -5b\ \ -5c]\]
Why: Each entry is the row \([a\ b\ c]\) times one column of \(P\); the zeros drop out because \(P\) is diagonal.

Compare entries
\[-5a = 30 \Rightarrow a = -6\]
\[-5b = 20 \Rightarrow b = -4\]
\[-5c = -5 \Rightarrow c = 1\]
Why: Equal matrices have equal corresponding entries.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The answer key prints "8. \(A'(-6, -4, 1)\)". The question asks for \(A\); \(A'\) is the given image \((30, 20, -5)\). The point \((-6, -4, 1)\) is \(A\), not \(A'\).
